exact_reason: The preserved sealed study contract declares a single fixed model arm (BASELINE_13_RAW), model.selection=null, and no execution.modeling_driver_relpaths. The authorized Phase D protocol requires six direction-by-stop-arm cells, a bounded multi-configuration expanding 2021->2022 and 2021+2022->2023 evaluation protocol, score-decile/first-fire/timeout/regime-level diagnostics, and per-candidate model persistence. No existing declared governed driver composes that protocol for this study. Running a new study-local or ad-hoc driver would be outside MODELING_EXECUTION_CLOSURE and would bypass the required contract/freshness/audit lifecycle.
